ai_summary: Aadhar Housing Finance reported a strong Q1 FY27 with robust financial performance, achieving 19% year-on-year growth in Profit After Tax (PAT) to ₹282 crore and an 18% increase in Assets Under Management (AUM) to ₹31,364 crore. The company also demonstrated stable asset quality, with Gross NPA on AUM improving by 3 basis points to 1.31%. While disbursements initially appeared lower due to a reporting basis change, on a comparable "cheque handover" basis, they grew strongly by 19% YoY, indicating overall healthy business expansion with no material red flags.
